svg.aria-label: Two loops: the Closed Loop inside the Open Loop (Wick edition)
svg.title: Two loops: the Closed Loop inside the Open Loop (Wick edition)
svg.desc: The Owner moves a Task to Ready. A Cycle spawns one Worker in its own git worktree, unless the Task is Gated. The Worker runs a Closed Loop with no human: build, test, review, fix. Then the Worker opens the PR and moves the Task to In Review, and the next Cycle sends in_review. The Open Loop is open at the bottom, where input comes in: a Review comment or ACTION Follow-up from a trusted author, or a failed Check, gives a Respawn in the same worktree. Comments from bots and other users are skipped. When the Owner marks the PR ready and merges it, the next Cycle moves the Task to Done and sends done. No agent merges. A Worker that cannot go on is Blocked and asks the Owner. Wick, the mascot, marks four states: the Working Worker inside the Closed Loop (amber glow), the Gated Task (a grey Wick waiting, in a card), the Respawn (a Wick reads a teal note) and the Blocked Worker (a Wick holds up a red card).
